an6.72:1.1: “Bhikkhus, a bhikkhu who has six qualities can’t attain strength in concentration.
an6.72:1.3: It’s when a bhikkhu is not skilled in entering concentration, skilled in remaining in concentration, or skilled in emerging from concentration. And they don’t practice carefully and persistently, and they don’t do what’s suitable.
an6.72:1.4: A bhikkhu who possesses these six qualities can’t attain strength in concentration.
an6.72:2.1: A bhikkhu who has six qualities can attain strength in concentration.
an6.72:2.3: It’s when a bhikkhu is skilled in entering concentration, skilled in remaining in concentration, and skilled in emerging from concentration. And they practice carefully and persistently, and do what’s suitable.
an6.72:2.4: A bhikkhu who possesses these six qualities can attain strength in concentration.”
